supersedes_if_adopted.reason: Development selection favored nonpaged bitsandbytes AdamW 8-bit, while frozen V2 specifies adamw_torch.

optimizer.basis: Step48 quality-selected development path used nonpaged bitsandbytes AdamW 8-bit and survived the frozen 64-case development milestone 62/64 over step40.

rationale.minimal_delta_principle: Change only the optimizer field supported by development evidence; do not silently turn development scaffolding into the final algorithm.
rationale.scheduler_reason: The staged development path's repeated scheduler resets were never isolated as a beneficial factor and are not equivalent to a full continuous epoch.
rationale.warmup_reason: Warmup3 was preregistered for the full run and was never directly falsified by the development work; retain it unless a separate experiment explicitly tests it.
rationale.acceleration_reason: FLA/Triton was mechanically qualified but was not used in the step48 quality-selected training trajectory.

runner_dry_validation.method: CPU-only validate_execution_spec on copies of frozen V2 contract/spec with only optimizer changed to adamw_bnb_8bit
runner_dry_validation.note: This proves the current protected runner's contract/spec validator accepts the minimal optimizer delta. It does not grant authority or prove full-run performance.

required_rebinding_if_adopted: New experiment contract version/schema identity or new exact experiment_id; do not mutate V2 in place.
New execution spec SHA reflecting adamw_bnb_8bit.
New execution binding SHA because the exact execution spec hash changes.
Re-run fail-closed training preflight against the new exact subject.
Final-bank admission/sealed commitment must bind the new exact subject before plaintext exposure or training.
Materialize a new exact one-run authority receipt only after all bank/custody gates pass and Patrick's current exact authority applies.

current_gate_state.timing_note: Because zero final-bank cases are admitted, this is the lowest-cost point to supersede the subject if the optimizer changes.

hostile_checks.challenge: Does step48 prove the proposed V3 full run will outperform V2?
hostile_checks.answer: No. It supports the optimizer choice only within short development stages. V3 would remain a new exact subject whose final performance is unknown until the single protected full run and sealed final evaluation.

hostile_checks.challenge: Why retain warmup3 when dev used zero warmup?
hostile_checks.answer: Zero warmup was part of bounded development scaffolding, not an isolated winning factor. Preserving the preregistered full-run warmup minimizes untested changes.

hostile_checks.challenge: Why not initialize the final run from step48?
hostile_checks.answer: That would violate the fresh-adapter subject and leak development checkpoint selection into the protected full-run subject. The proposal keeps parent_adapter null.
